content.title: 不定式作表语(The Infinitive as the Predicative)速查
content.intro: 当主语是 advice/dream/aim/plan/job/wish/question/problem 等抽象名词时,系动词 be 后常用动词不定式(to do)或'疑问词+不定式'作表语,说明主语的具体内容。判断口诀:主语是抽象名词 + be + 要做的事 → to do。

rows: My advice is to start early. / Her dream is to become an artist.
The question is what to paint. / The problem is how to begin.
be to do(计划/职责/将来)
The plan is to hold an exhibition. / The task is to repair it.
His hobby is painting.(说明'是什么活动',非计划/职责)

specialRules.rule: 主语为 advice/dream/aim/wish/plan 等抽象名词 → be 后多用 to do 作表语
specialRules.mark: My wish is to raise him well.

specialRules.rule: 内容是'做什么/怎么做/是否做'的问题 → 用'疑问词(what/how/where/whether)+ to do'
specialRules.mark: The problem is how to begin.

specialRules.rule: plan/task/duty/aim 表'计划·职责·将来' → to do;hobby/interest/job 指'日常活动' → doing
specialRules.mark: plan is to hold √ / hobby is painting √

specialRules.rule: 不定式表语 ≠ 动名词表语:看主语含义,不是随意互换
specialRules.mark: aim is to win / pleasure is walking

why: 不定式带有'将要/目的'的意味,所以 advice/dream/plan/aim 等'要去实现的内容'用 to do;动名词强调'正在/经常进行的活动本身',所以 hobby/interest 等用 doing。
gaokaoPoints: be 后填非谓语:主语是 aim/plan/wish 等抽象名词时选 to do,而非 doing/done/do;语法填空与改错高频。
'疑问词 + to do'作表语:The question is what/how/where/whether to do …,注意疑问词后直接接不定式。

examVsReal.exam: My advice is to start early.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.note: 考试用不定式作表语点明主旨;口语常直接用祈使句或省略

examVsReal.exam: The plan is to hold an exhibition.(考试)
examVsReal.real: We're going to hold an exhibition.
examVsReal.note: 考试爱用'主语+be+to do'表语句式;口语更常用 be going to
